Meeting Agenda Generator

Build a timed meeting agenda — add items with durations, get total time, then copy or download the agenda as text.

Total time: 0 min

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the meeting title and date.
  2. Add agenda items with durations.
  3. Copy or download the finished agenda.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What goes into an agenda item?

Each item has a title, an owner (optional), and a duration in minutes. Add as many as you like.

Does it total the time?

The tool totals all durations and shows the meeting length live as you edit.

Can I remove items?

Yes — remove any item with its ✕ button; the total updates instantly.

How do I share the agenda?

Copy the formatted agenda or download it as a .txt file to share.
